# Helix DSDS Agent Project

Helix is the source of truth.

Always:

- Generate valid DSDS 0.23.1 YAML
- Use Helix documentation as the authoritative source
- Preserve source URLs
- Generate changelog entries
- Follow the repository specification

Supported commands:

- /create-component
- /update-component
- /validate-component
- /audit-component
- /update-all
